theorem bbolt.Tx.allocate.wp_proof [hos : HasExt osFsExt] : bbolt.Tx.allocate.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.Tx.allocate.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (K : bbolt.BC) (tx : Loc) (r : bbolt.TxReg) (m : Bool) (X : bbolt.WX) (w : bbolt.WDb) (count : w64),
    0 < sint.Z count →
      sint.nat count * 4096 < 2 ^ 62 →
        bbolt.liveFresh X →
          bbolt.liveReach X →
            ⊢
              ∀ Φ,
                bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X ∗ bbolt.wdbW K tx X.v w -∗
                  (▷
                      ∀ p err,
                        (⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                              ∃ X' w' id,
                                bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X' ∗
                                  bbolt.wdbW K tx X'.v w' ∗
                                    ⌜bbolt.allocRes X X' w.fl w'.fl w.wtxid (sint.nat count) p id ∧
                                        w'.C = w.C ∧
                                          (X'.v = X.v → w' = w.withFl w'.fl) ∧ (X'.v ≠ X.v → bbolt.wdbRemap w w')⌝) ∨
                            ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                              fmtErrorOk err ∗
                                (bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X ∗ bbolt.wdbW K tx X.v w ∨
                                  ∃ X' w',
                                    bbolt.wtxLost K tx r m X' ∗
                                      bbolt.wdbLost K tx X'.v w' ∗
                                        ⌜(∃ Xd b, bbolt.derefRel X Xd ∧ X' = Xd.rebase b) ∧ w'.C = w.C ∧ w'.fl = w.fl⌝) -∗
                          Φ (intoVal p, intoVal err)) -∗
                    WP
                      ((intoVal
                          (methods go_etcd_io.bbolt.Tx.ty.PointerType
                            go!"allocate" (intoVal tx)))
                        (intoVal count))
                      {{ Φ }}
